ocl:
context Customer
inv: (self.cart <> null) and (self.customerId <> null)

context Category
inv: self.products->any(x | x.basePrice <= 100) <> null

context OrderItem
inv: self.quantity >= 53 and self.quantity <= 80

context InventoryItem
inv: self.quantity >= 76 and self.quantity <= 99

context Product
inv: (self.variants->collect(x | x.priceDelta)->sum() >= 7) and (not(self.variants->collect(x | x.priceDelta)->sum() >= 7))

context ProductVariant
inv: (self.product <> null) and (not(self.product <> null))

context Customer
inv: ((self.customerId <> '') and (self.addresses->forAll(v | v.postalCode <> ''))) and (not((self.customerId <> '') and (self.addresses->forAll(v | v.postalCode <> ''))))

context CartItem
inv: ((self.quantity <> null) and (self.cart.customer.email <> '')) and (not((self.quantity <> null) and (self.cart.customer.email <> '')))

context OrderItem
inv: (self.unitPrice >= 72 and self.unitPrice <= 93) and (self.unitPrice < 72)

context ReturnRequest
inv: ((self.item <> null) and (self.order.customer.fullName <> '')) and (not((self.item <> null) and (self.order.customer.fullName <> '')))

context Cart
inv: ((self.items->any(x | x.quantity < 10) <> null) and (self.customer <> null)) and (not((self.items->any(x | x.quantity < 10) <> null) and (self.customer <> null)))

context Product
inv: (self.reviews->collect(x | x.rating)->sum() >= 1) and (not(self.reviews->collect(x | x.rating)->sum() >= 1))
